paragraph1: Dry Bath Spray with Golden Siren Fragrance helps make the fur soft, fluffy, and refreshingly scented without the need for rinsing. Suitable for all breeds of dogs and cats. Easy to use, safe, and free from harsh chemicals that can cause skin irritation. It does not trigger allergic reactions and also helps reduce the buildup of fungi, yeast, and bacteria.
